blocks.prompt: 7 Given the function \[f(x) = \begin{cases} 2x + 3, & x \le 1 \\ -x + 4, & x > 1 \end{cases}\]Discuss the limit and continuity at \(x = 1\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein do kaam hain: pehle limit ke baare mein batana (exist karti hai ya nahi), phir continuity ke baare mein.
Function do tukron mein hai aur formula \(x = 1\) par badalta hai.
Plan: \(f(1)\), LHL aur RHL nikalein; LHL = RHL se limit ka faisla, aur teen shartein se continuity ka faisla.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(x \le 1\) ke liye \(f(x) = 2x + 3\), aur \(x > 1\) ke liye \(f(x) = -x + 4\).
Humein find karna hai: \(x = 1\) par limit aur continuity.
Tareeqa: \(f\) point \(x = c\) par continuous (lagataar, bina toote) tab hota hai jab teen shartein poori hon: (i) \(f(c)\) defined ho, (ii) \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x)\) exist kare yani LHL = RHL, (iii) yeh limit \(f(c)\) ke barabar ho. Agar ek bhi shart toot jaye to \(f\) wahan discontinuous hai. Aasaan zubaan mein: graph ko us point par qalam uthaye baghair bana sakein to continuous.

Shart (i): \(f(1)\) nikalein
\[f(1) = 2(1) + 3 = 5\]
Kyun: Pehle tukre ke saath \(x \le 1\) hai, is liye 1 pehle tukre mein aata hai.

Left hand limit nikalein
\[\lim_{x \to 1^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 1^-} (2x + 3)\]
\[= 2 + 3 = 5\]
Kyun: 1 se pehle (0.9, 0.99) pehla tukra \(2x + 3\) lagta hai.

Right hand limit nikalein
\[\lim_{x \to 1^+} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 1^+} (-x + 4)\]
\[= -1 + 4 = 3\]
Kyun: 1 ke baad (1.1, 1.01) doosra tukra \(-x + 4\) lagta hai.
Dhyan dein: \(-x\) mein \(x = 1\) rakhein to \(-1\) aata hai; minus sign ko na bhoolein.

Shart (ii): kya limit exist karti hai?
\[\text{LHL} = 5\]
\[\text{RHL} = 3\]
\[5 \ne 3\]
Kyun: Left se function 5 ki taraf ja raha hai aur right se 3 ki taraf. Do alag manzilein hain, is liye limit exist nahi karti.

Faisla
Shart (ii) toot gayi, is liye \(f\) point \(x = 1\) par discontinuous hai.
Kyun: Teen shartein mein se ek bhi toot jaye to function discontinuous hota hai; teesri shart check karne ki zaroorat hi nahi. Graph yahan height 5 se neeche height 3 par chhalaang lagata hai, yani qalam uthana parta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[f(0.99) = 1.98 + 3 = 4.98\]
\[f(1.01) = -1.01 + 4 = 2.99\]
Kyun: 1 ke dono taraf values do alag numbers (5 aur 3) ke qareeb hain. Yeh jump ka saaf saboot hai.
blocks.final_answer: LHL \(= 5\), RHL \(= 3\): \(\lim_{x \to 1} f(x)\) exist nahi karti, is liye \(f\) point \(x = 1\) par discontinuous hai
